definitionZh: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的

example.text: She studied ancient history at university and wrote her thesis on the Roman Empire.
example.translationZh: 她在大学学习古代史，并以罗马帝国为题目写了毕业论文。

definitionEn: n. short account of an incident (especially a biographical one)
definitionZh: n. 轶事, 奇闻

example.text: At dinner, my grandfather told a funny anecdote about his first day at work.
example.translationZh: 晚饭时，我祖父讲了一件关于他第一天上班的趣事。

definitionEn:
n. a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance
n. the state of being angry
v. make angry
v. become angry
definitionZh: n. 忿怒\nvt. 激怒, 使发怒\nvi. 发怒

example.text: He slammed the door in a fit of anger.
example.translationZh: 他一怒之下摔上了门。

definitionEn: a. feeling or showing anger\ns. (of the elements) as if showing violent anger\ns. severely inflamed and painful
definitionZh: a. 生气的, 愤怒的

example.text: She was angry with her brother for breaking her favorite cup.
example.translationZh: 她因为弟弟打碎了她最喜欢的杯子而生他的气。

definitionEn: n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement\ns. marked by the appetites and passions of the body
definitionZh: n. 动物\n[医] 动物

example.text: Lions are wild animals that live in the savanna.
example.translationZh: 狮子是生活在热带草原上的野生动物。

definitionEn: n a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
definitionZh: n. 动物, 动物世界；牲畜（animal的复数形式）

example.text: The children love watching the animals at the zoo.
example.translationZh: 孩子们喜欢在动物园里观看动物。

definitionEn: n. a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus
definitionZh: n. 踝\n[医] 踝, 踝关节

example.text: She slipped on the icy steps and twisted her ankle.
example.translationZh: 她在结冰的台阶上滑倒，扭伤了脚踝。

definitionEn: v kill in large numbers
definitionZh: vt. 消灭, 废止

example.text: The advancing army annihilated the enemy forces before dawn.
example.translationZh: 推进的军队在黎明前歼灭了敌军。

definitionEn: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)
definitionZh: n. 周年纪念

example.text: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary with a quiet dinner at home.
example.translationZh: 他们在家安静地吃了一顿晚餐，庆祝结婚十周年。

definitionEn: n. a formal public statement\nn. a public statement containing information about an event that has happened or is going to happen
definitionZh: n. 公告, 发表, 告知\n[经] 通告, 布告, 公告

example.text: The company made an announcement about the new product launch.
example.translationZh: 公司发布了关于新产品上市的公告。

definitionEn: v. cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
definitionZh: vt. 使恼怒, 骚扰

example.text: The constant noise from the construction site began to annoy the residents.
example.translationZh: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音开始惹恼居民。

definitionEn: n. income from capital investment paid in a series of regular payments
definitionZh: n. 年金, 年金保险, 年金领受权\n[医] 年金, 年俸

example.text: After retirement, she receives a monthly annuity payment from the insurance company.
example.translationZh: 退休后，她每月从保险公司领取一笔年金。

definitionEn: a. having no known name or identity or known source\ns. not known or lacking marked individuality
definitionZh: a. 姓氏不详的, 无名的, 无特色的\n[计] 无记录

example.text: The reporter refused to reveal the name of the anonymous source.
example.translationZh: 记者拒绝透露那位匿名消息来源的姓名。

definitionEn: n. the relation between opposing principles or forces or factors\nn. an actively expressed feeling of dislike and hostility\nn. (biochemistry) interference in or inhibition of the physiological action of a chemical substance by another having a similar structure
definitionZh: n. 对立, 敌对, 敌意\n[化] 拮抗作用; 消效作用

example.text: His antagonism toward the new manager was obvious to everyone in the office.
example.translationZh: 他对新经理的敌意办公室里的每个人都看得出来。

definitionEn: n. the region around the south pole: Antarctica and surrounding waters
definitionZh: a. 南极的, 南极地带的\nn. 南极地区

example.text: Scientists from many countries travel to the Antarctic region to study its ice and wildlife.
example.translationZh: 来自许多国家的科学家前往南极地区研究那里的冰层和野生动物。

definitionEn: n. a preceding occurrence or cause or event\nn. anything that precedes something similar in time\nn. the referent of an anaphor; a phrase or clause that is referred to by an anaphoric pronoun
definitionZh: n. 前情, 先行词\na. 先前的, 先行的

example.text: The treaty had its antecedents in earlier trade agreements between the two nations.
example.translationZh: 这项条约的渊源可以追溯到两国早先的贸易协定。

definitionEn: n. a song of devotion or loyalty (as to a nation or school)
definitionZh: n. 圣歌, 赞美诗

example.text: The crowd stood and sang the national anthem before the game.
example.translationZh: 比赛开始前，人群起立唱国歌。

definitionEn: n. a collection of selected literary passages
definitionZh: n. 选集, 诗选

example.text: The editor compiled a poetry anthology featuring works by young writers.
example.translationZh: 编辑编纂了一本收录年轻作家作品的诗集。

definitionEn: n. the social science that studies the origins and social relationships of human beings
definitionZh: n. 人类学\n[医] 人类学

example.text: She decided to study cultural anthropology to better understand how different societies organize family life.
example.translationZh: 她决定学习文化人类学，以更好地理解不同社会如何组织家庭生活。

definitionEn: n. a chemical substance derivable from a mold or bacterium that can kill microorganisms and cure bacterial infections\na. of or relating to antibiotic drugs
definitionZh: n. 抗生素\na. 抗生的

example.text: The doctor told me to take antibiotics for a week to clear the infection.
example.translationZh: 医生让我服用抗生素一周，以清除感染。

definitionEn: n a chemical substance derivable from a mold or bacterium that can kill microorganisms and cure bacterial infections
definitionZh: n. 抗生学；抗生素

example.text: The doctor prescribed a course of broad-spectrum antibiotics for the infection.
example.translationZh: 医生为感染开了一个疗程的广谱抗生素。

definitionEn: n. an expectation\nn. something expected (as on the basis of a norm)\nn. anticipating with confidence of fulfillment
definitionZh: n. 预期, 预料\n[医] 提前出现(如遗传病)

example.text: The crowd waited in eager anticipation of the concert.
example.translationZh: 人群热切地期待着音乐会的开始。

definitionEn:
n. any piece of furniture or decorative object or the like produced in a former period and valuable because of its beauty or rarity
v. shop for antiques
v. give an antique appearance to
s. made in or typical of earlier times and valued for its age
definitionZh: n. 古董, 古物\na. 古老的, 古风的, 旧式的, 过时的

example.text: She found a beautiful old clock in an antique shop downtown.
example.translationZh: 她在市中心的一家古董店里找到了一座漂亮的旧钟。

definitionEn: n. a word that expresses a meaning opposed to the meaning of another word, in which case the two words are antonyms of each other
definitionZh: n. 反义词

example.text: "Hot" is the antonym of "cold".
example.translationZh: “热”是“冷”的反义词。

definitionEn: n. (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic\nn. a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune
definitionZh: n. 焦虑, 忧虑, 令人焦虑的事\n[医] 焦虑

example.text: She has suffered from anxiety since she started her new job.
example.translationZh: 自从开始新工作以来，她一直饱受焦虑之苦。
